name: MiniCPM5-2B q4f16_1, OpenAI-compatible chat
summary: MiniCPM5-2B quantized to q4f16_1 for WebLLM/WebGPU. Entries preserve the OpenAI-compatible chat contract while tuning runtime and model-library artifacts for a specific browser/GPU configuration.

source.precision: q4f16_1 weights, float16 activations and KV cache

request.tools: Optional OpenAI-compatible tool declarations; they disable the catalog's exact-greedy fast path when they install a grammar or logit processor.
request.stream: Boolean. Streaming chunks follow WebLLM's OpenAI-compatible delta shape.

response.text: choices[0].message.content for non-streaming, or concatenated choices[0].delta.content for streaming.
response.usage: OpenAI-compatible prompt/completion token counts plus WebLLM latency fields when enabled.

generation.fastPath: Exact greedy GPU-resident decode (burst size 1 with GPU lookahead 1 for this entry) only when temperature is zero and no logprobs, penalties, grammar, logit bias, structured output, or custom logit processor is active.
generation.fallback: All other requests use the normal WebLLM one-token sampler and keep the same API contract.

verification.case: Six rotating fresh LaTeX prompts plus four math/prose/code/low-margin quality prompts.
verification.bar: Six of six fresh prompts are byte-identical to the published path on every tested round. Four of four quality prompts are byte-identical to a local plain K=1 reference. No published-sampler nondeterminism was observed for this model.

notes: Weights and tokenizer remain in the immutable upstream repository. The catalog entry carries metadata plus verified runtime JS and model-library WASM references. Unlike every Qwen3 family in this catalog, the model library does not use WebGPU subgroups: subgroup GEMV reduction changes the accumulation order enough to flip a near-tie logit on one tested prompt, so exact-greedy parity requires dropping subgroups and keeping TVM's default GEMV TR=64. This is the same class of cosmetic base-vs-sg32 divergence already documented for the Qwen3 families (identical LaTeX, unequal token count), not a MiniCPM5-2B-specific defect; there is no mlc-ai/subgroup-32 publication for this model, so exactness was defined against the only published no-subgroup library. The reused runtime JS is the 1.7B/4B/8B lookahead bundle.
